description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: An empty inclined woven reading panel has a broad lower ledge and two plain retaining arms. Side: A folding bamboo easel leg sets a fixed reading angle. Rear: The rear exposes the easel hinge and crossed panel stiffeners. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Show rear supports, rear surfaces and described rear features. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
